caution.warningAndCautionPara: A successful check shows that the record has not been edited through normal means. It does not prove that nobody with access to the server's files rebuilt the whole chain.

row.entry: Chain intact, with the number of signed entries
Every entry matches its fingerprint and links to the entry before it.
Problems found: content changed after signing
An entry was edited after it was written.
Problems found: does not link to the entry before it
The chain has been broken or rebuilt.
One or more entries were deleted.
The console could not reach the server.

proceduralStep.para: If problems were found, write down the entry numbers shown. Do not take further actions on the console. Report the result to whoever is responsible for the server.

closeRqmts.reqCond: The chain is intact, or a problem has been reported.
